mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that typically precedes Federal Reserve rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and rising FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.5% annualized) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.0% year-over-year), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns due to anticipated monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: In periods meeting the late-cycle expansion regime, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates improving job market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units signals weakening residential construction, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces household wealth and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion regime (INDPRO > 105.0 and GDPC1 growth above 2.0% annualized), robust manufacturing and economic output support corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the supply-driven expansion regime, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.
